_metadata.description: Complete entity field data for the Integraciones Externas vertical slice (IESS + Contable)

screens.description: Interfaz IESS - Genera archivos de interfaz con el IESS (aportes, planillas)
operations: Executes stored procedure PY_ArchivoInterfasIess
Generates text file from AvPyInterfasarchivo records
File download (descargaArchivo) or remote transfer via shell script (pasainterfaznomina.sh)
Opens BotIESSCargaDescDialog for automated IESS bot

screens.description: Carga Rubros IESS - Upload/compare planillas IESS vs sistema Avante, validación y aprobación
operations: File upload (Fileupload) of IESS planilla files
Parse uploaded file to create AvPyRubrosIess (header) and AvPyRubrosIessl (detail lines)
Compare IESS data vs Avante data (sueldos, aportes)
Approve/Inactivate records via context menu (mniAprobar, mniInactivar)
Export to Excel (HSSFWorkbook)
Jasper report generation
Search/filter by Agencia, Estado, Colaborador
BOT planillas IESS integration (AWS SenderAWS)

screens.description: Interfaz Contable - Genera archivos de interfaz contable (nominales y financieros)
operations: Receives P_iIdeEjecProceso and P_iIdEmpresa as creation params
Executes stored procedure PY_ArchivoInterfasCon with output param vTipo
Generates text files from AvPyInterfasarchivo records
Two modes: download file (verification) or write to server path + execute shell (financial)
Shell script: pasainterfascontable.sh for financial file transfer
Rights check: button_GenInterfasContableFinancial, button_GenInterfasContableVerificacion

screens.description: Contabilización - Ejecuta contabilización de procesos de nómina (asientos contables)
operations: Receives P_iIdeEjecProceso, P_iIdDmLocalidad, P_iIdColaborador as params
Gets list of processes from AvPyRubroslHisDAOJpaImpl.getprocesosejecucion()
Gets instances to contabilize from AvPyContabilizacionpDAOJpaImpl.getinstanciascontabilizar()
Verifies rubros without accounting template (getRubrosSinCtaContable)
Executes stored procedure PY_ContabilizaProcesoTIA for each instance
Executes stored procedure PY_ContabilizaPrestNoDesembolso for non-disbursement loans
Confirmation dialog before execution

screens.description: Consulta Contable - Consulta asientos contables por rubro con resumen Debe/Haber/Nómina/Diferencia
operations: Query detalle contable x rubro via AvPyRubroslHisDAOJpaImpl.getdetallecontablexrubro2()
Export to Excel (HSSFWorkbook) with 7 columns
Opens ReporteIRINECDialog.zul for IR/INEC reports
Processes are loaded with checkboxes from getprocesosejecucion()

screens.description: Reporte Contable Financiero - Genera reportes de nómina contable y cuenta/subcuenta con filtros
operations: Generates CSV report via shell scripts (generarCuentaSubCuenta.sh or generarNominaContable.sh)
CSV file download from /usr/share/avante/decode/
Dynamic form: shows/hides sections based on report type and checkboxes
Colaborador search via extended dialog (ColaboradoresExtendedSearchListBoxAdvance.zul)
Rubro filtering by clasificación (AvPyClasesrubro)

screens.description: Consulta Cuadre Contable - Cuadre de provisiones contables consolidado por rubro
operations: JPASearchObject query for AvPyCuadreprovcontable filtered by empresa, anio, mes
PagedListWrapper for server-side pagination
Double-click opens consultaCuadreContablexColabList.zul detail
Export to Excel (HSSFWorkbook) with 13 columns

screens.description: Consulta Cuadre Contable por Colaborador - Detalle de provisiones por colaborador dentro de un cuadre
operations: Receives cuadrecontable (AvPyCuadreprovcontable) and parent controller as creation params
JPASearchObject query for AvPyCuadreprovcontableDet filtered by iidcuadrecontable
Search by cedula or apellidosnombres (OR filter with ILIKE)
PagedListWrapper for server-side pagination
Export to Excel (HSSFWorkbook) with 15 columns (includes Estado and Zona)
Modal dialog window
